group: Global Admin - Protected from scoped user-admins

steps.description: POST /authentication/admin/users - create ga-user-admin@node
GET /authentication/admin/users/:email - capture the account id of ga-user-admin@node
POST /authorization/system/subject/:subject/role - assign user to ga-user-admin@node
POST /authorization/system/subject/:subject/role - assign user-admin to ga-user-admin@node
POST /authorization/system/subject/:subject/role - make ga-user-admin@node an org admin of the organization of the global-admin
POST /authentication/admin/users - create ga-outsider@node, a user in no organization
POST /authentication/login - login as a user-admin without global-admin
GET /authentication/admin/users/:email - a scoped user-admin reads the global-admin, a member of its organization
GET /authentication/admin/users/:email - 404 for a scoped user-admin reading a user outside its organizations
POST /authentication/admin/users/:email/disable - 404 for a scoped user-admin disabling a user outside its organizations
GET /authentication/admin/account/managed - a scoped user-admin manages only the members of its organizations
GET /authentication/admin/account - capture the identity item of the global-admin
PUT /authentication/admin/users/{{adminEmail}}/password - 403 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
POST /authentication/admin/users/{{adminEmail}}/disable - 403 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
POST /authentication/admin/users/{{adminEmail}}/enable - 403 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
DELETE /authentication/admin/users/{{adminEmail}} - 403 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
DELETE /authentication/admin/account/{{gaAdminIdentityItemId}} - 403 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
PUT /authentication/admin/account/{{gaAdminIdentityItemId}} - 403 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
POST /authentication/admin/account - 403 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
DELETE /authentication/admin/organization-request/account/{{adminAccountId}} - 403 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
POST /authorization/system/subject/{{gaUserAdminAccountId}}/role - 401 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
DELETE /authorization/system/subject/{{adminAccountId}}/role/global-admin - 401 for a user-admin acting on the global-admin
POST /authentication/login - the global-admin can still sign in with its password
POST /authentication/login - restore admin session
GET /authentication/admin/users/:email - the global-admin reads a user in no organization
DELETE /authentication/admin/users - remove the user in no organization
DELETE /authentication/admin/users - remove the user-admin
